title: The Green Hornet
paragraphs: Modern urban masked-crimefighter adventure created at WXYZ. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 314 objects: 312 dated original-run recordings from 1938-1952, one undated archive item, and a 1975 Al Hodge interview.

GRH documents the program through WXYZ local/regional era (January 31, 1936 to April 7, 1938) on [[org|org.a0d8a72797b5185f|WXYZ]], Mutual network era (April 12, 1938 to November 9, 1939) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], Blue/ABC long network era (November 16, 1939 to September 8, 1950) on [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], and Final return (September 10, 1952 to December 5, 1952).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are George W. Trendle (creator on 273 recordings, producer on 259 recordings, and performer on 18 recordings), Lee Allman (performer on 263 recordings), Gilbert Shea (performer on 257 recordings), Charles D. Livingstone (director on 237 recordings), Rollon Parker (performer on 179 recordings), Fran Striker (writer on 73 recordings, performer on 36 recordings, editor on 21 recordings, script supervisor on 17 recordings, and script editor on 6 recordings), and Dan Beattie (writer on 124 recordings and performer on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.a0d8a72797b5185f|WXYZ]] (originated at station), [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network), and [[org|org.666407112636e085|Michelson]] (syndicated by).
